por_que: Proposal A keeps the light-wood Nordic palette the client asked for across nearly every piece: an ash desk, a 200 cm birch bookcase wall that fills the right wall, a birch bentwood rocker and a white drum-shade lamp. Proposal B mixes a white-stained bookcase, a green wingback, a grey metal task lamp and a white chair on a black base, so it loses the light-wood look and reads as unrelated pieces.

B delivers the light-wood Nordic look the client asked for more consistently. A works, but its white bookcase, green wingback and grey lamp drift from the 'maderas claras' brief and feel less unified.
